normal.name: lertsenem
normal.text: I'm kinda getting mad at Deep Dish Dungeon. The game absolutely nails the coop exploration, dungeon crawling, and overall level design. But the collect/craft/cooking part is so boring and tedious it physically hurts. I feel like with a good UI it would be bearable, but it's awful too. Maybe I've been too pampered by Satisfactory excellent controller interface? Anyway, despite all that I'll keep exploring because the rest of the game is that good. #videogames #reco #DeepDishDungeon
